title: Classroom Daily Teaching & Learning Loop
description: The pedagogical heartbeat for educators: daily attendance roll call with offline sync resilience, lesson plan preparation, assignment dispatch, and holistic student radar attunement.

intents.title: Conduct Daily Classroom Roll Call
intents.outcome: Mark attendance for all enrolled students with instant local feedback and resilient background sync.

journeys.title: Record Daily Student Attendance
journeys.situation: A teacher opens their classroom workspace at the beginning of the morning session to take attendance across their active student roster.
journeys.outcome: Attendance states (present, late, excused, unexcused) are captured in local SQLite and synced to the school record.
preconditions: Authenticated account has active teacher bond for the classroom.

existingBehavior: AttendanceScreen provides individual and batch student attendance marking.
AttendanceView renders the daily classroom attendance snapshot.
teacherRollCallFlow defines the declarative flow sequence.
invariants: Roll call marks must save to local SQLite immediately so connectivity drops in classrooms do not interrupt the teacher.
Attendance records must be idempotently upserted by student_id and date.
openQuestions: How should multi-period secondary school attendance differentiate from primary morning roll call?

steps.title: Open Classroom Roster
steps.interaction: Navigate to classroom attendance and load the current date roster.

steps.title: Mark Student Presence
steps.interaction: Tap status pills for each student or use Mark All Present.

transitions.title: Begin Roll Call
transitions.feedback: Status indicators update with haptic feedback.

transitions.title: Finalize Roll Call
transitions.feedback: Snapshot is stored locally and sync status indicator reflects queued upload.

requirements.title: Resilient Offline Attendance Capture
requirements.statement: Attendance marks must save to local SQLite WAL without network dependency, synchronizing automatically when connectivity resumes.

bindings.title: Attendance Screen
bindings.note: Provides roll call UI with tactile status toggles.

bindings.title: Teacher Roll Call Flow DAG
bindings.note: Flow DAG defining roll call steps and fallbacks.

bindings.title: Active Period Dispatcher
bindings.note: Computes current and upcoming period from timetable_periods and enables 1-tap roll call.

scenarios.title: Complete Daily Morning Roll Call
scenarios.expected: All enrolled students are marked and attendance record is persisted.

intents.title: Attune to Student Holistic Radar & Growth
intents.outcome: Observe student emotional wellbeing, focus, and holistic growth vectors.

journeys.title: Holistic Radar Attunement
journeys.situation: A teacher notices a learner struggling or thriving and checks the student's holistic growth radar to adapt instruction.
journeys.outcome: Teacher gains non-intrusive insight into emotional and cognitive balance.
preconditions: Authenticated account has authorized teaching relationship with the student.

existingBehavior: ClassroomHolisticInsights displays student radar and wellbeing cards.
invariants: Private reflective journal text is never disclosed to teachers; only aggregate radar energy vectors are visible.
openQuestions: What sensitivity thresholds should trigger proactive guidance prompts for the educator?

steps.title: Open Holistic Insights
steps.interaction: Navigate to the classroom insights tab.

steps.title: Review Growth Radar
steps.interaction: Inspect balance across focus, vitality, and emotional serenity.

transitions.title: Examine Student Radar
transitions.feedback: Render Skia radar polygon with current growth balance.

requirements.title: Strict Learner Privacy Preservation
requirements.statement: Attunement views must display aggregate pedagogical metrics without exposing private thoughts or personal journal text.

bindings.title: Classroom Holistic Insights Component
bindings.note: Renders non-invasive radar and wellbeing telemetry.

scenarios.title: Inspect Learner Holistic Radar
scenarios.expected: Radar graphic displays student growth dimensions without private diary text.

intents.title: Teach next from what the class answered
intents.outcome: The next lesson aims at real misconceptions.

journeys.title: Respond to what the class answered
journeys.situation: A teacher has run a check or exit ticket and wants to know what to teach next.
journeys.outcome: The teacher sees the most common wrong answers and either reteaches or sends a note to someone who grew.
preconditions: The person has opened Gurudevi on their own device.

invariants: No student is named, ranked or labelled.
openQuestions: Whether 'who might need help' appears at all, and how it is worded.

steps.title: Open the class view
steps.interaction: After a check, open what the class answered.

steps.title: Read common wrong answers
steps.interaction: Per question: answered, right, right alone, most common wrong answers. No names.

steps.title: Reteach or send a note
steps.interaction: Plan a reteach, or send a growth note to a student who did alone what needed help before.

transitions.title: See the answers
transitions.feedback: Questions are ordered as in the activity.

transitions.title: Act
transitions.feedback: A note goes through the relation; a reteach is noted for the next lesson.

requirements.title: The class view names no one
requirements.statement: The class answer view is computed when read from attempts the teacher may see, is never stored, and names no one; it says what the class answered, not who is behind.

requirements.title: Formative loop
requirements.statement: Teachers can see common wrong answers after a check and adjust teaching, as in the ASSISTments trials. Project doc claude/learning-that-works.md (evidence, 14 Nov 2026).

scenarios.title: Reteach after a check
scenarios.expected: The teacher targets the most common misconception; no student is named or ranked.
